newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SON OF ROMANIA'S CEAUSESCU DIES IN VIENNA.
newsitem.headline: SON OF ROMANIA'S CEAUSESCU DIES IN VIENNA.

text.p: Nicu Ceausescu, son of Romania's late communist dictator Nicolae Ceausescu, died in hospital in Vienna on Thursday, a hospital spokeswoman said.
"Mr Ceausescu died at 6 a.m. (local time, 0400 GMT) this morning," the spokeswoman at Vienna's General Hospital told Reuters. She gave no further details but said a statement was in preparation.

Nicu, 45, who was suffering from liver disease, was admitted to Bucharest university hospital on September 14 with internal bleeding and was flown to the Austrian capital last week for specialist treatment.

Nicu was being groomed as his father's successor before a violent revolution toppled the Stalinist dictatorship in December 1989. Nicolae Ceasescu and his wife, Elena, were shot by firing squad on Christmas Day.
Nicu was later sentenced to 20 years in jail on charges of mass murder after ordering the repression of protests in his fiefdom of Sibiu. He was released on health grounds in November 1992.
